description:
Use this when an emissions or footprint record (JSON) needs checking against Open Footprint or sector guardrails before storing or reporting. Not for data-quality questions without a payload. Costs 1 credit ($0.01).

Checks structure, constraints, enums and calculations; with a sector, its guardrails. Per call read `checked`, `checks_not_run` and `schema.coverage.constraintsDeclared`. Not checked: undeclared ranges, unit coherence, referential integrity, factor provenance. Compliant only if sector_policy is in `checked` and policy.outcome is passed. `schemaValid` is structural; `valid` is deprecated.
name: ofp_validate
title: Validate data against Open Footprint
